Minior Showers: Orionids runs through October 24 at 11:59 p.m., with increased encounters daily from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. The current five-star and Mega Raid bosses are Palkia and Mega Charizard X/Y.

October 24Global + in person

Lake Trio Max Battle Day runs from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time. The FC Seoul collaboration is limited to the Seoul World Cup Stadium area from 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., with boosted Shiny odds and free Timed Research.

Month-end and Wild weekOct 27–Nov 15

Halloween Part I starts October 27, followed by Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day on October 31. Into the Wild has a separate Raid or Max Battle hour each day from November 9–13, then leads into Pokémon GO Wild Area: Global.

Morelull Spotlight Hour on October 22 from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time offers 2× Catch Stardust. Minior Showers: Orionids has increased encounters daily from 5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. through October 24 at 11:59 p.m.

Use Dragon or Fairy attackers against Palkia. Mega Charizard X calls for Dragon, Ground, or Rock; prioritize Rock against the Y form. See Current Raid Counters for exact teams and moves, while Dynamax Sneasel favors Fighting-type Max attackers.

Save resourcesOct 24–31

Lake Trio Max Battle Day runs from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time on October 24; October 26 Max Monday features Sableye. Chandelure Super Mega Raid Day on October 31 has boosted Shiny odds and up to six free Raid Passes, so reserve the local 2:00–5:00 p.m. window.
